confirmedFindings.title: In-Place Rate Trie Mutation During Active Call Rating
confirmedFindings.body: Inserting new rates directly into the active trie instance while concurrent rating queries are traversing it introduces a data race where lookups read partially linked trie nodes, resulting in rating misses or unhandled exceptions.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Build a new Radix Trie instance off-thread and perform an atomic pointer swap.
